# MadeinAtlas

> > Authentic Moroccan artisanal home decor and handcrafted furniture, directly sourced from Atlas craftspeople.

MadeinAtlas specializes in authentic Moroccan home decor, furniture, and accessories handcrafted by local artisans in Morocco. The site features a curated collection of traditional pieces including Berber textiles, brass fixtures, thuya wood items, and boho-style furnishings, with multilingual support in English, French, German, and Arabic.

## Key Topics

- Moroccan home decor
- Berber textiles
- Boho furniture
- Brass fixtures
- Thuya wood
- Handmade crafts
- Artisan products
- Moroccan brass tables
- Hamsa serving dishes
- Beni Ourain style
- Kilim patterns
- Tagine ceramics
- Atlas region
- Traditional craftsmanship
- E-commerce
